overview.title: Overview
overview.lead: What matters in your kitchen right now.
overview.sampleNoticeText: The app is not connected to a database yet. The items and numbers below are made up to show how the overview will look.

chicken.name: Chicken breast
chicken.advice: Use it today, or freeze it before the day is over.

mince.name: Minced beef
mince.advice: Do not eat. A use-by date is about food safety.

milk.name: Semi-skimmed milk
milk.advice: Best before often means good after. Look, smell and taste.

yoghurt.name: Natural yoghurt
yoghurt.advice: Often still fine. Look, smell and taste before throwing it out.

inventory.emptyText: Here you will add items, see what expires soon, and record what you use and throw out.

recipes.lead: Dinner ideas based on what you already have.

shoppingList.lead: What to buy next time you shop.

budget.emptyText: Here you will register purchases, set a monthly food budget and see spending per category.

household.lead: Share the pantry and shopping list with the people you live with.
